name: Roger Trundle Memorial Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Two-year scholarship for UQ civil engineering students facing financial, educational, geographic or cultural disadvantage.
key: $15,000 per year for up to 2 years.
who: Domestic student with documentary evidence of financial and/or educational disadvantage, geographic isolation and/or cultural disadvantage.
Enrolled full-time in the BE(Hons), BE(Hons)/Master of Engineering, or an engineering dual.
Has completed at least 12 but not more than 34 units in civil engineering.
how: Apply through the UQ application portal with a cover letter, resume, mySI-net studies report, evidence of financial hardship and short written answers.

evidence.quote: can provide documentary evidence of financial and/or educational disadvantage
